definition: the sharing we do when we eat away from home, and when food gets ordered in

settled:
Eating out is mostly with Jen, and we split the food. Usually one main course between us, which portions it naturally, and usually a dessert or two as well, because she loves treats.

Costco samples belong in the same column.

Takeaway and delivery come in when everybody needs feeding and Jen has no capacity to cook. That one is gated on capacity rather than chosen.
